in_hebrew.name: כֹרֵלִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Corly is derived from the Hebrew word 'korel' meaning 'strong one of God'. This name was likely used for a warrior or someone who was strong in their faith.

in_greek.name: Κορλυ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Corly in Greek means 'maiden' or 'virgin'. This name may have been given to a young girl or a woman who was pure and untouched.

in_latin.name: Corlus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Corly in Latin is derived from the word 'cor' meaning 'heart' and 'lus' meaning 'spear'. This name may have been given to a warrior who was strong in both heart and battle.
